correctness.rationale: Decompose L=U+V+Z with V=Z=F_q[T]/(T^n-1). For x=a u0+b u1+w+z, im(ad_x)=(a+bT)R+span{w,Tw}. With zero pencil, rank of (w,Tw) is 0,1,2, and cyclic shift has g one-dimensional eigenspaces over F_q, even if char divides n. Nonzero unit pencil gives rank n; exactly g(q-1) nonunit linear pencils have image codim1, raised to n iff w outside ideal, counting q^{n-1} rank n-1 vectors per pencil. Multiply all counts by q^n central choices; ranks distinct when n>=4, sum q^{2n+2}. At n4 evaluate q=3^k odd/even k to get gcd 2/4, excluding any single rational polynomial. Independent direct bracket-matrix Gaussian elimination checked small finite fields/ranges, including n4 q2,3,5 and n5,6; the unbounded formula rests on cyclic-module proof.
